*Automated reports board* — ops home for Worker-automated report status (migrated from Discord `#automated-reports`).

*Full reference (canvas):* <https://rootmcworkspace.slack.com/docs/T0BM02SM1FE/F0BMX9FP716|RootMC automated reports board>

Tracks last daily / weekly / monthly report posts (combined, economy, towns, nations, awards, dividend).

*Note:* The Worker still *edits a live Discord board message* after each report (webhooks can’t update a sticky Slack post). This Slack channel is the canonical bookmark; Discord is `#automated-reports-legacy`.

Related: <#C0BLMHKTCTH> *Sent using* Cursor
